value_streams.name: Enterprise Shared Content & Capabilities
value_streams.definition: Enterprise-wide shared semantic, governance, reference, platform and enabling content/capabilities that are reused across VS01–VS05 and are not exclusively owned by any operating Value Stream.
value_streams.stage_status: NOT AN OPERATING VALUE STREAM — NO VALUE-STAGE MODEL REQUIRED

value_streams.name: Asset Provision & Access
value_streams.definition: Transform a validated requirement for productive-asset access into an agreed, provisioned and accepted asset-access arrangement, while originating and orchestrating associated lease and insurance requirements for specialist execution by VS02 and VS03.

value_streams.name: Asset Finance & Capital Provision
value_streams.definition: Transform a validated lease or financing requirement handed over from VS01 into an assessed, structured, approved, funded and serviced financing exposure that is ultimately settled, refinanced, transferred or distributed.
value_streams.family: S03 — Credit Origination & Servicing + P07 Capital, Treasury & Funding Management

value_streams.name: Asset Risk Protection & Recovery
value_streams.definition: Transform a validated insurance/protection requirement handed over from VS01 into effective protection and, where a covered loss occurs, into an administered and settled recovery outcome.

value_streams.name: Asset Lifecycle Performance
value_streams.definition: Transform lifecycle/service demand originated by ServiceCo under an active Master Service Agreement into sustained and optimised productive-asset performance through condition monitoring, maintenance, reliability intervention and authorised lifecycle exit.

value_streams.name: Investment & Portfolio Value Realisation
value_streams.definition: Transform an investment thesis, strategic opportunity or capital-allocation requirement into an evaluated, approved, executed and governed investment position or strategic transaction, including senior-debt investment into FinanceCo, that produces authorised value realisation.

value_streams.name: Mining Production & Delivery
value_streams.definition: Creates stakeholder value by converting approved mining contract requirements and mine production plans into delivered mining production that meets agreed quantity, quality, schedule, safety and commercial performance requirements. The value stream covers the end-to-end flow of production delivery and excludes mine asset lifecycle support, maintenance, reliability, spares, tyres, GET, fuel support and related equipment-life-support activities, which remain governed within VS04 Asset Lifecycle Performance.
value_streams.family: S02 — Productive Asset / Fleet Operations (moved from VS04) + surface mining production

architecture_requirements.name: Governance
architecture_requirements.statement: TOGAF Standard, 10th Edition and Technical Corrigendum 1 shall be the target enterprise architecture method and content baseline.

architecture_requirements.name: Method
architecture_requirements.statement: Kongoni shall maintain a controlled tailoring of the ADM, including engagement triggers, iterations, phase gates and deliverables.

architecture_requirements.name: Architecture Domains
architecture_requirements.statement: Every material enterprise architecture shall address Business, Data, Application and Technology domains at an appropriate level of detail.

architecture_requirements.name: Transformation
architecture_requirements.statement: Every target architecture shall trace to a baseline, gaps, building blocks, transition architectures and an approved roadmap.

architecture_requirements.name: Principles
architecture_requirements.statement: Architecture decisions shall conform to approved principles or carry a time-bound CEO-approved exception.

architecture_requirements.name: Business Architecture
architecture_requirements.statement: Capabilities shall remain canonical enterprise abilities; value streams shall be stakeholder value-flow views; processes shall operationalise work.
architecture_requirements.verification_artifact: Capability, Value Stream and Process Metamodel

architecture_requirements.name: Kongoni Tailoring
architecture_requirements.statement: The approved Kongoni capability, ontology, business-model and system-boundary rules shall remain controlled tailoring unless formally changed.

architecture_requirements.name: Requirements
architecture_requirements.statement: Architecture requirements shall be sourced, owned, prioritised, versioned, traced to content and linked to verification evidence.

architecture_requirements.name: Repository
architecture_requirements.statement: Architecture content shall have one authoritative source, controlled status, owner, version, repository path and supersession link.

architecture_requirements.name: Implementation Governance
architecture_requirements.statement: Material implementations shall pass architecture compliance gates before production unless an approved exception exists.

architecture_requirements.name: CRM Boundary
architecture_requirements.statement: Zoho CRM shall be the operational execution and task-tracking layer; it shall not replace the authoritative architecture repository.
architecture_requirements.verification_artifact: CRM Action Map and Task Records

architecture_requirements.name: Executive Accountability
architecture_requirements.statement: MY Task List shall remain the single executive accountability register; CRM Tasks shall track delegated operational execution only.

architecture_requirements.name: Evidence
architecture_requirements.statement: Every alignment assertion shall be supported by controlled evidence and a recorded test procedure.

architecture_requirements.name: Change Management
architecture_requirements.statement: Architecture baselines, targets, principles and roadmaps shall be reviewed at least quarterly and upon material change triggers.

architecture_requirements.name: Reference Licensing
architecture_requirements.statement: TOGAF publications and templates shall be used in accordance with applicable The Open Group licensing and attribution conditions.
